name: clinizaro
description: Clinic CRM for Klinik Seri Ayu — leads, WhatsApp inbox, doctor scheduling, walk-in queue, device sessions and an AI receptionist. Next.js 16, Drizzle, Postgres with a zero-config PGlite demo mode.

paragraphs: A clinic CRM for Klinik Seri Ayu — patient leads, a WhatsApp inbox, doctor scheduling, a walk-in queue, device sessions and an AI receptionist, in one ledger-styled workspace.

Clinizaro is a front-office CRM for a multi-doctor clinic. It follows a single patient from the first enquiry through to a completed treatment — capturing the lead, answering them on WhatsApp, booking the slot, calling their queue number, and scheduling the recall.

The interface is deliberately styled as a clinic ledger: paper stock, ruled lines, tabular figures, rubber date stamps and a serif/sans pairing, so it reads like the front-desk book the staff already know.
features: Pipeline across baru → dihubungi → layak → ditempah → rawatan → selesai plus hilang
Engagement temperature (panas / suam / sejuk), source attribution and owner assignment
Filter by stage, source, engagement or owner, with free-text search over name, phone, interest and notes
Per-lead drawer with the full event timeline, WhatsApp transcript, uploaded documents and visit history
Staff notes, stage changes, next-follow-up scheduling, CSV export
